card.name: The word responsiveness in dosing text
card.fires_on: Mostly the noun "responsiveness" (to a drug, or of a patient) in dosing and treatment-response sentences. Weaker on a few other abstract nouns or sentence-opening words, such as "Summary" or "Recommended".

modes.label: Responsiveness
modes.description: The word "responsiveness" describing how a patient or vessel reacts to a drug.
modes.example: after 1 month of treatment at 20 mg/kg per day [see Warnings and Precautions (5.4) ] . Once<< responsiveness>> to sapropterin dihydrochlor

modes.label: Other scattered nouns
modes.description: Occasional other words at the start of a clause or heading, such as Summary, transformations, Whenever or Recommended.
